# Fiscal boundary gate — legacy debt baseline (RATCHET)
#
# This file is NOT an allowlist for new code. It records violations that already
# existed when the gate was moved to pull requests, so the gate can block new
# debt without freezing the repository.
#
# RULES:
#   1. Entries may ONLY be removed. Adding an entry requires a reviewer decision
#      and a linked issue explaining why the violation cannot be fixed now.
#   2. Never baseline a file you are creating or modifying in the same PR.
#   3. When you fix a violation, delete its line here in the same commit.
#
# Format: <repo-relative-path> :: <trimmed matching line>
# The gate matches on path + code content (not line numbers) so the baseline
# survives unrelated line shifts.
#
# Burn-down tracking: docs/01-foundation/program-taxonomy.md
